# E0109: a version file uses CUE's struct shorthand

A version file writes every struct with its braces, so that a lens body, a
lacunas key and a schema read the same way. CUE's struct shorthand, `a: b: c`,
is refused wherever it appears, in a schema or in a lens body; thema's
formatter expands it.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	meta: owner: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	meta: {
		owner: string
		team:  string
	}
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: meta: team: "unassigned"
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0109]: meta: owner: ... is CUE's struct shorthand, which a version file does not use
 --> history/0.0.thema:2:8
  |
2 |     meta: owner: string
  |           ^^^^^
  |
  = note: every struct in a version file keeps its braces, so that a lens body, a lacunas key and a schema read the same way
  = help: write meta: {owner: ...}

error[E0109]: v1_0: meta: ... is CUE's struct shorthand, which a version file does not use
  --> 1.0.thema:10:8
   |
10 |     v1_0: meta: team: "unassigned"
   |           ^^^^
   |
   = note: every struct in a version file keeps its braces, so that a lens body, a lacunas key and a schema read the same way
   = help: write v1_0: {meta: ...}

error[E0109]: meta: team: ... is CUE's struct shorthand, which a version file does not use
  --> 1.0.thema:10:14
   |
10 |     v1_0: meta: team: "unassigned"
   |                 ^^^^
   |
   = note: every struct in a version file keeps its braces, so that a lens body, a lacunas key and a schema read the same way
   = help: write meta: {team: ...}
```
